caveats: The totals cover the four reported categories, including Piriven; they are not a count of every education provider. These national aggregates do not describe individual schools, classroom crowding, teacher subjects or district inequalities. Pupil–teacher ratios are published whole-number ratios, not class sizes. New admissions cover government schools only. Totals overlap their school-type components.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One national education measure, school type and year; totals overlap category counts
notes: Annual national Ministry of Education figures for 2022–2025, compiled by DCS. The school types are government schools, government-approved private schools, special schools and Piriven. The table includes category counts, totals, published pupil–teacher ratios and new government-school admissions.
